page.notes: The right side of the page is cut off, so most lines end mid-word; the visible parts are transcribed only. The woodcut initial E is in a box, and the word it begins is hidden. The running head and heading are partly cut. Uncertain readings: "Sess." (printed Seff.), "Meritis" (printed Meritiu), "Justif." (hyphenated across lines). The cut-off lines are not marked illegible; they simply end where the scan ends. The ornament row of fleurons is decoration and is not transcribed. The left edge is cut away, so the opening words of the heading and several lines begin as fragments. Readings marked [?] are doubtful: the "Ei" in the heading, the start of the Council reference, and "no" before "Sic illi" are not clear. The gap after "Anathe-" is unreadable.
